## Independently recorded review ledger

Ledger records remain separate from triage reports. Accepted assessment counts are applied only when source, image bytes, focus geometry, content and (for defaults) ordered page-group hashes match. A sentinel warning clears only with an explicit independent exception whose structured scope and kind match the whole-spell-unmarked policy. Legacy exception records lacking those fields remain visible and actionable.

- highlight: confirmed 1117, exception 154
- crop: confirmed 1637, defect 5
- context: confirmed 1241
- default: confirmed 15

## Full-image sentinel warning policy

Every raw full-image sentinel remains visible in the review workflow. A whole-spell exception clears a sentinel warning only when the region contains only the full-image sentinel rectangle and the current independent review is hash-exact with scope=whole-spell and kind=whole-spell-unmarked. Mixed-focus regions retain an actionable warning, even when a matching review records a whole-spell exception. This policy does not establish source completeness or mechanics correctness, and it never waives field-target focus.

| Policy unit | Count | Denominator / meaning |
|---|---:|---|
| Raw full-image sentinel bindings | 2185 | Current region-binding denominator |
| Unresolved sentinel highlight warnings | 2183 | Raw sentinels minus explicit current pure whole-spell exceptions |
| Unreviewed or suspected sentinel bindings | 2031 | Current sentinel bindings |
| Mixed-focus sentinel bindings | 0 | Regions with a sentinel plus one or more precise focus rectangles |
| Whole-spell exception reviews rejected for mixed focus | 0 | Hash-exact exception reviews that cannot clear mixed-focus sentinels |
| Current exact exceptions pending scope review | 152 | Hash-matched sentinel exceptions lacking explicit scope/kind |
| Historical exceptions pending scope review | 152 | 154 recorded highlight exceptions |
| Historical exceptions with explicit whole-spell scope | 2 | Same historical exception denominator |
| Explicit whole-spell exceptions | 2 | Current pure sentinel exceptions meeting both required fields |
| Field-target bindings reviewed | 757 | 4681 field-evidence bindings |
| Fact-focus pending | 3924 | Field bindings without field-target-reviewed status |
| Field value paths missing | 0 | Counted separately; not a resolved target |
| Sentinel-linked field targets pending | 0 | 0 field bindings linked to sentinel regions |

Field-to-region review is an independent dimension. A whole-spell highlight exception never clears a pending or missing field target.
